nodes.rationale: Paths are encodeURI then encodeURIComponent because GoatCounter stores browser percent-encoded Korean paths; ?start= bypasses cached 404s; no // comments because Chirpy compresses HTML to one line.

nodes.label: Multiple CUDA Version Management (runfile + CUDA_HOME/PATH)
nodes.rationale: Runfile install places each version in /usr/local/cuda-X.Y; per-shell CUDA_HOME/PATH override is most recommended; global /usr/local/cuda symlink affects all users so never change it on shared servers.

nodes.label: gpu_fan_control.py Fan Curve Script
nodes.rationale: Forces fan speed via temperature curve; restores default fan policy on exit because manual set switches policy.

nodes.label: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES / CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER Device Mapping
nodes.rationale: nvidia-smi/nvtop indices may differ from CUDA ordinals; use UUID or PCI Bus ID.

nodes.label: Blog Motivation: Recording Self-Study Trial and Error
List Multiplication Aliasing ([[]]*(n+1) vs list comprehension)
nodes.rationale: [False]*(n+1) is safe because bool is immutable; [[]]*(n+1) shares one mutable list, so comprehension is used for adjacency lists.

nodes.label: PyTorch In-place Operations
nodes.rationale: Out-of-place preferred unless safe, since in-place can overwrite values needed by autograd backward.

nodes.label: Voxelization / Devoxelization of Point Clouds
nodes.rationale: Point clouds are unordered; voxel grid gives order so 3D patch embedding can be applied without a VAE.

nodes.label: 3D Window Attention
nodes.rationale: Extra spatial axis makes token count cubic; key reduction claims O(L^2/R^3), but official code mixes window/global blocks and infers with global model.

nodes.label: DiT-3D Reproducibility Issues (no seed fixing, S/4 vs XL/4 variance)
Momentum (EMA) Teacher
nodes.rationale: EMA lambda 0.996->1 cosine gives slowly moving stable target; without momentum centering collapses to 0.1%.

nodes.label: Multi-Crop (2 global 224 + local 96 views)
nodes.rationale: Accuracy gains saturate (6->10 crops +0.2%p) while time/memory grow.

nodes.label: Centering and Sharpening
nodes.rationale: Centering prevents single-dim dominance, sharpening prevents uniform collapse; balanced together.

nodes.label: DINO Projection Head (3-layer MLP, l2 bottleneck, K=65536)
Dual-Level Patch/Pixel Architecture
nodes.rationale: Global semantics via short patch sequence (p=16), texture via low-dim (D_pix=16) pixel path.

nodes.label: Pixel-wise AdaLN
nodes.rationale: Expands each patch semantic token into distinct per-pixel scale/shift/gate; improved gFID 3.50->2.36.

nodes.label: Pixel Token Compaction
nodes.rationale: Compresses p^2 pixel tokens to one D-dim token for global attention; without it 82,247 GFLOPs and OOM vs 311.

nodes.label: REPA (Representation Alignment)
nodes.rationale: Aligns 8th patch layer with frozen DINOv2 (lambda 0.5); removing it worsens gFID 1.97->4.33.

nodes.label: Dual-Timestep Scheduling
nodes.rationale: Per-token two noise levels keep marginal p(t) while creating information asymmetry, reducing train-inference gap vs masking or diffusion forcing.

nodes.label: EMA Teacher Feature Alignment Loss (L_rep)
nodes.rationale: Student layer l aligns with EMA teacher layer k>l on cleaner input; replaces external encoders that fail to scale and hurt video/audio.
